tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately on a clean transparent watch glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the in-house visual specification.
tests.source: Marine Collagen Peptide__STM for Marine Collagen Peptide NEW.txt:30

tests.procedure: Stepwise solubility (USP descriptive terms): 100 mg sample in a stoppered tube with 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min (repeat once if not dissolved); add 0.9 mL, then 2 mL, then 7 mL solvent with the same shake and hold to classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble; if still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble.

solvents: water (per spec sheet; the STM says only 'the solvent')
details.reference: USP 2024 Description and Relative Solubility; In-house Method for Marine Collagen Peptide

tests.source: Marine Collagen Peptide__STM for Marine Collagen Peptide NEW.txt:31

tests.procedure: Viscosity (USP <912> rotational methods): dissolve about 15 g sample in water and make up to 100 mL with the same solvent; warm the solution to about 40 °C; measure with a calibrated viscometer.

details.sample: about 15 g in water, made up to 100 mL
details.reference: USP <912>; In-house Method for Marine Collagen Peptide

tests.source: Marine Collagen Peptide__STM for Marine Collagen Peptide NEW.txt:32

tests.procedure: Loss on drying (USP <731>): weigh an empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C and cooled in a desiccator (W0); weigh accurately 1.000 g sample into it (W1 = bottle + material); dry in a calibrated oven at 105 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % loss on drying = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.drying: calibrated oven 105 °C, 2 h, then to constant weight
details.reference: USP <731>; In-house Method for Marine Collagen Peptide

tests.source: Marine Collagen Peptide__STM for Marine Collagen Peptide NEW.txt:33

tests.procedure: Protein content (Kjeldahl, titrimetric): digest 100 mg collagen in the flask with 5 g of a potassium sulfate : cupric sulfate : titanium dioxide (33:1:1) mixture and 7 mL sulfuric acid until clear light green and free of carbonaceous material; add 70 mL water and cool; steam distil after adding 30 mL sodium hydroxide solution (2 in 5) under the acid layer, collecting into 15 mL boric acid solution (1 in 25) with 3 drops methyl red-methylene blue TS until the distillate is 80-100 mL; titrate with 0.1 N sulfuric acid VS, blank correction. Protein (%) = (EP - B) x 0.1 x 14 x F x 6.25 / (W x 1000) x 100.

details.digestion: 5 g K2SO4 : CuSO4 : TiO2 (33:1:1) mixture; 7 mL sulfuric acid; heat until clear light green
details.receiver: 15 mL boric acid solution (1 in 25) with 3 drops methyl red-methylene blue TS
details.titrantStandardization: dilute 1.4 mL sulfuric acid to 500 mL; 0.1 g anhydrous sodium carbonate in 20 mL water, methyl orange, titrate to reddish colour; 1 mL 0.1 N sulfuric acid = 5.295 mg sodium carbonate
details.equivalence: 1 mL 0.1 N sulfuric acid = 1.4 mg nitrogen
details.formula: Protein (%) = (EP - B) x 0.1 x 14 x F x 6.25 / (W x 1000) x 100; EP end point, B blank end point, F titrant correction factor, W sample weight (g)
details.reference: Analytical Method Validation Report for Content of Protein in Collagen
